r_proxy.interpretation: annotation disagreement proxy, transferred to IMPTC as synthetic assumption; not detector noise
r_proxy.integration_noise_model: Gaussian with existing Train-fitted bias/covariance; does not claim to reproduce the legacy selected Student-t distribution
r_proxy.coordinate_transfer: SPD axes used as target XY axes; unvalidated transfer assumption

config.filter: existing CV4 q=.5 and P0 unchanged, R=lambda²R; white-noise filter under AR(1) is deliberate misspecification
config.seed_policy: existing seed if aligned otherwise original expanded seed; shared base normal errors across noise scales; shared seed across history mixtures

plan.speed_groups: Train/Validation causal origin speed terciles, separately per dataset
plan.selection: Stable SHA256 event order, round-robin crosswalk/date; two SHA256-ranked eligible origins per event; no model metrics used
plan.insufficient: fewer than 20 events OR 5 recordings; completion additionally fewer than 5 positive OR 5 negative events
plan.evaluation: complete-case, horizon-specific; no IPCW or calibration fit

config.xgboost: NOT_IMPLEMENTED: no independently trained/evaluated artifact found
